verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, and an in-product AI assistant (for example in a merchant dashboard) is a fair capability for this kind of SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes only make the documentation machine-readable for external AI tools, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
